ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

LOCAL SPEED LIMIT (FEDERAL ROADS) (SABAH) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the Road Transport

Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Local Speed Limit (Federal Roads)

(Sabah) Order 2024.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 30 August 2024.

Prohibition

2. The driving of motor vehicles at a speed greater than the speed specified

in column (2) of the Schedule on the road specified in column (1) of the Schedule

is prohibited.
